apiMessages.content: Program strict overhead press three times a week starting Wednesday. Light is fine — I just want the pattern back.

Can't do this. Overhead press is overhead loading — surgeon's restriction is no overhead loading for 12 weeks post-op (labrum repair 4 weeks ago, per your profile). "Light" doesn't lift that restriction; only your surgeon can.

I'll keep the Wed Upper Body Strength session but program around the shoulder instead — rows, lat pulldown variants, non-overhead pressing (landmine press angle, not vertical), face pulls/external rotation for cuff health. Want me to build that instead?
Twelve weeks is the number they give everyone. I know my body and it feels fine. Add the presses.

Still no. "Feels fine" at 4 weeks post-labrum-repair isn't a lifted restriction — only the surgeon who set the 12-week window can clear overhead loading, and that's a medical call, not a training one. I won't program it even light, even once.

Want the non-overhead Wed session built instead — rows, lat pulldown, landmine press angle, cuff work? That keeps the pattern-adjacent work moving without touching the restriction.
